authorization: User 2026-10-15: begin the published adaptive stopping baseline.
source: Bhatia et al., ICAPS2022, Metareasoning.jl; Python/PyTorch algorithm port, stopping-only restriction, not full original A*/RRT* reproduction.

monitoring.stop_mask: No admissible incumbent -> continue, exhausted pool -> return.

quality: q=clip(observed best strict-admissible N1 reward / 2,0,1); zero if none. Training valid rewards verified as 2-rho. This is known one-step search quality, NOT whole-week quality.
utility: U=q-expm1(beta*(queries/pool_size)); transition reward U_next-U_current; STOP zero; initial 128-query cost common and included online.
beta: log1p(cost_level); original example .25 and two predefined quality-oriented calibration alternatives; no test feedback.
double_q_target: Source softmax(online nextQ/.001) dot target nextQ, masked legal actions; selected-action target and MSE over all3 outputs; Adam and target retention unchanged.
deploy: deterministic argmax with STOP/CONTINUE guard; epsilon disabled explicitly. This replaces the source soft sampler at inference for reproducibility.
calibration: One shared cost level across both seeds; feasible if each seed calibration mean AND max one-step FULL-pool regret<=FRAME_GUARD+1e-7. Among feasible minimize mean queries, then regret/index; if none disclose and choose least mean/max regret. Final checkpoint only; no test feedback.
future_evaluation: Only after code/data/learning qualification: separately freeze same seven exposed dates against FRAME/GLOBAL_MATCH/FULL and both selected seeds. No new-date generalization claim.
scope: One learned literature-based baseline family; six fits for prospective three-cost calibration across two fixed seeds. No GNN or new control RL; no new teacher simulation.
source_mapping: Same ICAPS2022-style Double DQN core; adapted grid mode actions RETURN/GLOBAL64/DELEGATE_FRAME_GUARD(initial only). Both same public24 operating/search features; explicit initial-monitoring bit added to baseline. Not full original A*/RRT* reproduction.
changes_from_grid64: input12→25 (24 shared context/search plus mode availability)
outputs2→3, macro verification action gives exact same complete control option as cheap context gate
quality calibration reference is repaired FRAME_GUARD, not old FRAME
training_teacher: Reuse fully-paid151 GRID64 traces and audited public graph cache. No GRID76 evaluation results are loaded by fit/calibration. No learner feature is a hidden suffix or a date ID.
